text:
jen_finance: Heads-up: I see repeated small GPU charges labeled as "parking" in us-central1 for 2026-03-28 overnight windows. Total looks ~ $9.6k across three nights. No team label on most rows. Can infra confirm what "parking" is?

arun_infra: Parking is our ephemeral-hold feature for preemptible removal grace period. It should copy labels from the parent instance; if metadata sync fails they land untagged. Looking at the export now. Please paste sample resource ids.

jen_finance: Sample resources in drive: https://drive.company/drive/file/parking-sample.csv (top rows: park-gpu-uc-01, park-gpu-uc-02, burst-hold-3).

billing-bot: [anomaly] id=ANOM-20260328-PRK group=us-central1 metric=gpu_parking_spend change=+38% window=2026-03-26..2026-03-28

kate_platform: Quick query I ran: ```SELECT resource_id, labels, SUM(cost) FROM `company_billing.gcp_export` WHERE labels NOT CONTAINS 'team' AND resource_name LIKE 'park-%' GROUP BY resource_id, labels;``` Shows 27 resources without team.

arun_infra: Plan: 1) run a targeted tag-backfill using instance metadata for park-* ids; 2) add retry for metadata read in parking controller; 3) add a nightly check to fail loudly if parking creates unlabelled rows. Backfill ETA 2h.

jen_finance: If backfill misses our invoice cutoff, can we do a provisional journal allocation? I'll prepare a template and need ops signoff. Estimate per-team impact: infra-tools +$4.2k, model-eval +$3.1k, sandbox +$2.3k.

ops-lead: I can approve a provisional journal with: exported rows, backfill job id, and RCA note. Approving conditional on reversal if pipeline reingests.

arun_infra: Backfill started job=BF-PARK-77. I'll paste the job link when done. Also opened PR to add retries: https://git.company/repo/pull/4821

jen_finance: Thanks. I'll prepare JRN-PARK-20260328 and leave it pending ops-lead approval. Please ping when the backfill finishes so we can decide final journal action.

billing-bot: [info] backfill_complete job=BF-PARK-77 matched=24/27 delta=$2.7k remaining_unmatched=$2.9k

kate_platform: Post-backfill: 24 rows matched to teams, remaining $2.9k unallocated. Recommend approving provisional journal for $2.9k then reverse if reprocessed.

ops-lead: Approved provisional JRN-PARK-20260328 for $2.9k. Reversal expected if additional rows reconcile. :white_check_mark:

jen_finance: Marking resolved. Will file audit memo and add the parking check to monthly finance checklist. Thanks all.
